content.comment_body: I need to change the date format on the [product_name] Operator Device to DD/MM/YYYY. Is this possible?

Unfortunately, I believe it's not possible to change the date format on the [product_name] Operator Device. I haven't seen any menu on the device for this function, and I doubt that changing the date format is supported.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking if the date format can be modified on the [product_name] Operator Device to match DD/MM/YYYY. The feedback suggests there is no available menu or option to adjust the date format, indicating limited flexibility and customization for users, particularly regarding localization preferences.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to configure the date format on the [product_name] Operator Device to better suit their regional or personal preferences.
